# `fluxsim gate`

Decide one AI-call request against a policy, or run the conformance vectors.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fluxsim gate decide`](#fluxsim-gate-decide) | decide one AI-call request against a policy |
| [`fluxsim gate conform`](#fluxsim-gate-conform) | run the RFC-04 conformance vectors against the enforcement gate |

## `fluxsim gate decide`

Decide one request against one policy. Exit 0 allowed, 3 denied, 1 the request could not be decided at all.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim gate decide [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# exit 0 allowed, 3 denied
fluxsim gate decide --request request.json
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--request` | `REQUEST` | the request to decide, as JSON -- fields: policy (object), request (object), skill (object) [optional] **(required)** |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |

## `fluxsim gate conform`

Run the published RFC-04 conformance vectors and report the pass count.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim gate conform [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# run the published conformance vectors
fluxsim gate conform
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--vectors` | `VECTORS` | path to an RFC-04 vectors file (default: the published set) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
